XECH Ellipse Clocks with Speaker – Smart Desk with 5W Bluetooth Audio

The XECH Ellipse Clocks with Speaker is a modern all-in-one desk essential designed for workspaces, bedrooms, and study areas. Combining a 5 W Bluetooth , digital alarm , ambient temperature display, and smart desk accessories, this compact device brings both functionality and style to your daily routine. Whether you need wireless music playback, time management, or a clutter-free desk, the delivers a seamless experience.

Equipped with a powerful 5 W Bluetooth, the provides clear, balanced sound with enhanced bass. It supports wireless audio playback from smartphones, tablets, and laptops, making it ideal for music, podcasts, video calls, and online meetings. With TWS (True Wireless Stereo) mode, you can pair two units together for immersive stereo or room-filling sound.

The integrated digital display with alarm function ensures accurate timekeeping with easy-to-read LED digits. The built-in alarm is perfect for daily reminders, wake-up routines, or meeting alerts. Alongside time, the ambient temperature sensor displays real-time room temperature directly on the LED face, helping you stay aware of your environment at a glance.

Designed for productivity, the with includes a that securely holds your smartphone. This feature is ideal for video calls, content viewing, recipe reading, or hands-free browsing. When not in use, the neatly folds away, maintaining the clean and minimalist look.

To keep your workspace organized, the device features a built-in This allows you to store pens, pencils, or styluses conveniently, reducing desk clutter and improving efficiency. The thoughtful design makes the a perfect addition to home offices, corporate desks, and student study tables.

Charging is effortless with the modern USB-C charging port, offering faster and more reliable power delivery compared to older connectors. The USB-C interface ensures compatibility with most modern chargers and cables, making daily charging more convenient whether at home or at work.

Key Features

  • Ambient temperature sensor showing room temperature on LED display
  • Retractable phone stand for video calls and content viewing
  • Pen-stand with dual slots to keep your desk tidy and organized
  • TWS mode to pair two units for stereo sound
  • USB-C charging for modern, convenient power input

The is ideal for users looking for a smart desk with Bluetooth functionality. Its multi-purpose design eliminates the need for separate gadgets, saving space while enhancing productivity. The sleek LED display complements modern interiors, making it suitable for bedrooms, offices, co-working spaces, and gifting purposes.

Whether you are streaming music, attending virtual meetings, checking the room temperature, or organizing your desk accessories, the adapts effortlessly to your lifestyle. With premium build quality, smart features, and reliable performance, it stands out as a practical and stylish desk companion. Upgrade your workspace today with the a perfect blend of sound, time, organization, and modern design.
